turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have about twenty minutes, Hale, and I'd like to spend them on Owen. Why did my son find out about a zero from his phone, in the middle of class?
The checker said 94 percent. That's the end of it.
A machine's guess. Even the company that sells it says not to use it alone, and I have their guide in my bag. Who decided on the zero, and did anyone speak to Owen before it went in?
I don't need more proof than that.
"I don't need more proof than that." Your own procedure says software alone doesn't establish a concern, and I printed it. So what else do you have, Hale, or is that all?
The software doesn't lie, unlike some people.
My child never lies. "Unlike some people." Name who you mean, Hale, because I'm writing it down.
Under 4.2 you were required to call me before any mark went in, and nobody did. I'm writing down "zero stands," and the principal will have it before I leave the building.
